mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3% MoM, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and UNRATE increase > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.
